Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.messenger

Interface MessengerProtocol

All Known Implementing Classes:
BridgeProtocol, IrcProtocol, P2pProtocol
public interface MessengerProtocol
A chat-network backend. This is the Messenger's extension point: the shipped IrcProtocol is a fully in-process native client, while the BridgeProtocol family reaches networks that need an external or native stack (XMPP, Matrix, Telegram, WhatsApp, Signal, SMS, SIP) by handing off to the official client / web app. Any future native protocol (for example an XMPP client built on Smack) plugs in by implementing this interface and registering with ProtocolRegistry — no UI change required.

All network I/O is asynchronous: connect(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.messenger.AccountConfig, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.messenger.ProtocolListener) returns promptly and reports progress through the ProtocolListener. Optional operations (channels, actions) have default no-ops so a minimal backend, such as a one-shot bridge, need not implement them.

    • sendFile

      default boolean sendFile(String target, Path file)
      Offers a local file to target. A no-op returning false for backends without MessengerProtocol.Capability.FILE_TRANSFER; a supporting backend starts the offer and reports progress through ProtocolListener.onFileTransfer(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.messenger.AccountConfig, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.messenger.FileTransferEvent).
      Parameters:
      target - the conversation target (a peer)
      file - the local file to send
      Returns:
      true if the offer was queued

    • acceptFile

      default void acceptFile(String transferId)
      Accepts an offered inbound file. A no-op unless the backend has MessengerProtocol.Capability.FILE_TRANSFER.
      Parameters:
      transferId - the offered transfer's id

    • rejectFile
